title: release_work answer
description: The memory tool release_work's answer (migration 081): this session's claim on a work item ended, with its id, so another may take it. released names the claim it ended (who held it and until when); unchanged true when no live claim held it. A release moves no revision and keeps no version; history records it (work_released). Another session's claim is refused (claimed); a person can release any claim from the app (app_memories release_claim). Listed and answered only with memory.tools and memory.work on, and refused (off) with the second off (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body.
